title: Refactor PHP Scripts to Eliminate Global Variables
problem_statement: Global variables in PHP scripts reduce maintainability and increase risk of side effects.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased maintenance burden and potential for unexpected behavior.
suggested_approach: Refactor scripts to use dependency injection or class properties.
success_criteria: No global variables present in PHP scripts.

provenance.evidence: Global variable usage for database connection.

title: Standardize SQL Table and Column Naming Conventions
problem_statement: Inconsistent naming conventions in SQL tables and columns can lead to confusion and potential errors.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential for errors and confusion in database operations.
suggested_approach: Review and refactor SQL scripts to use consistent naming conventions.
success_criteria: Consistent naming conventions across all SQL tables and columns.

provenance.evidence: Inconsistent naming in SQL table definitions.
